Class JavaFXApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.JavaFXApp
public class JavaFXApp extends javafx.application.Application
JavaFX entry point. Wires the LobbyController to the network stack and opens the lobby window.

Call launchGui(String, boolean) from

invalid reference 
ClientManager#main
when GUI mode is selected; the main method here is kept for direct IDE launches (defaults to localhost/socket).

    • rebuildStage

      private void rebuildStage()
      Rebuilds the primary stage with the StageStyle implied by the current fullscreen setting. JavaFX does not allow changing StageStyle on a live Stage, so we create a new one, move the scene over, and dispose the old.

    • getOrCreateSettingsStage

      private javafx.stage.Stage getOrCreateSettingsStage()
      Lazily builds the settings menu stage and returns it. The stage is owned by the current primary stage and behaves as a transparent overlay.

    • toggleSettingsMenu
